verdict.rationale: Discord's webhooks docs explicitly say apps can "receive event notifications from Discord delivered to your app over HTTP," which is a first-party outbound event-webhook capability. The rest of the pack does not count toward this story: the incoming webhooks in docs-5/42/43 only post messages into channels, and the Gateway delivers events over WebSocket. Missing for 10: details on how to register an endpoint and which event types are available, delivery and verification semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
